purpose: Official-source and safety boundary sidecar for the activation nutrition target slice.

sources.name: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025-2030
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and U.S. Department of Agriculture
sources.product_use: Provides the general official nutrition context for user-chosen daily targets. The app must not turn this into medical diagnosis, disease treatment, or body-shame copy.

sources.name: Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.product_use: Links nutrition target creation to training consistency and recovery context without prescribing a medical nutrition plan.

sources.name: TransformFit nutrition target safety protocol
sources.product_use: Requires user-selected targets, bounded units, source trace, conservative copy, and visible non-medical framing.

safety_rules: Every persisted target carries the phrase not medical nutrition advice.
The first activation target is user-selected and may be updated by the user.
The app does not prescribe calorie deficits, diagnose conditions, promise body outcomes, or use body-shame language.
Targets remain bounded by deterministic validation before they can be saved.
activation_kpi_trace: Activation requires onboarding, one goal, one logged workout, and one nutrition target within 24 hours.
